title: Fort Wayne Man Judged Competent to Stand Trial in Arson Case After Bizarre Garage Fire
excerpt: Christopher Peden, 36, was ruled competent to stand trial on a Level 4 felony arson charge after investigators say he set fire to a detached garage in Fort Wayne, Indiana, in May. A trial date has been set for May 2027.
content:
A Fort Wayne, Indiana, man accused of setting fire to his mother's detached garage in May has been judged competent to stand trial on a felony arson charge, court records show.

Christopher Peden, 36, appeared before a Superior Court judge in Fort Wayne on Oct. 29, 2026, for a competency hearing. The judge ruled Peden competent to stand trial and set a trial date for May 2027, according to The Smoking Gun, which reviewed court records. The ruling followed court-ordered evaluations by two psychologists.

Peden is charged with one count of Level 4 felony arson, which carries a potential sentence of up to 12 years in prison. He is free on a $10,000 bond.

According to a court affidavit sworn by a fire investigator, Peden went into the garage around 2 a.m. on May 6, 2026, and used a kitchen knife to sever his penis. He then poured gasoline on it and set it on fire on the floor of the garage, just inside the door, the affidavit states.

The fire spread beyond the garage, damaging two additional properties and two vehicles, according to reports. A neighbor alerted Peden's mother and brother, who were asleep in the home, to the blaze. Investigators recovered a red gasoline container, four lighters and a kitchen knife at the scene.

Police were separately responding to a reported stabbing nearby when they found Peden downtown claiming he had been attacked. At the hospital, he told investigators that account was "dishonest" and admitted the injury was self-inflicted and that he had started the fire, according to court documents cited by FOX59.

Authorities have not publicly said what led to the incident. Peden's brother, James, was charged separately over an alleged fire that burned Christopher Peden's car, WANE 15 reported.

Sources: The Smoking Gun, Oct. 30, 2026; FOX59; PEOPLE; USA TODAY; WANE 15.
